text: The owned change replaces atoi with strtoul and names the returned value ImapUid. It does not inspect an end pointer, conversion error or numeric range. Char-pointer scanning remains, and the accepted scanner later changes how it advances across digits and lines. The reviewer's negative-value concern explains the request; actual source proves the conversion change, not complete input validation or a platform-independent numeric result.
title: The SEARCH UID iterator adopts unsigned conversion but keeps pointer parsing
